hero.title: Product Engineer

summary.title: Product thinking, technical ownership, and a full-stack foundation
facts: Responsible for several Webel surfaces and their shared web architecture.
Full-stack experience building a Ruby on Rails product at AuroraJobs.
I work with agents through specifications, reusable skills, code review, and final validation.

webel.title: Webel
webel.intro: I am responsible for the web platform of this home-services marketplace: its B2C and B2B surfaces, internal dashboard, SEO, email, and shared component library.

areas.name: Webel Organizations
areas.description: The B2B platform for managing employees, services, calendars, leads, chat, tax details, service areas, schedules, and payouts.

areas.name: Marketplace core
areas.description: The B2C application for finding and browsing services. I migrated it from Angular to React, and it continues to evolve with the rest of the product.

areas.name: Programmatic SEO
areas.description: The content and acquisition surface. I moved it to Astro, which better fits its static, content-led architecture.

areas.name: Internal dashboard
areas.description: The internal tool for looking up users and services, managing incidents, and tracking business data.

projects.title: Lab
projects.intro: Prototypes and utilities I build on my own initiative. Each tests a specific idea and states its status without presenting it as paid work.

items.title: Define the problem
items.description: I work out who it is for, what needs to change, and the smallest solution worth building. I write down scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Set up the work
items.description: I split implementation into reviewable parts and give each agent the context it needs. Reusable skills and agent-ready design-system docs carry technical decisions across tasks.

items.title: Review and validate
items.description: I review the code, tests, and outcome against the specification. When a choice affects the product or architecture, I make it and update the context before work continues.

skills.title: Technologies I use to build the product

experience.title: Web products at Webel and AuroraJobs
experience.evolutionNote: AuroraJobs gave me my full-stack foundation. At Webel, I have taken responsibility for several web surfaces and their shared architecture.

contact.title: I want product responsibility alongside the code
contact.intro: I am looking for Product Engineer or Software Engineer roles where engineering takes part in defining the problem, scope, and decisions. I can also help teams turn loosely defined ideas into software people can use.
